summary: Prioritise climate-resilient infrastructure portfolios, compare delivery choices and strengthen oversight. Explore the course and review its practical outputs.
lede: Infrastructure portfolio prioritisation under climate and fiscal constraints helps public investment officials, utility executives and portfolio managers rank competing capital proposals. Participants practise setting entry gates, screening climate exposure, testing fiscal affordability, comparing delivery options and assigning risk ownership, then document selection criteria and portfolio results for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who set infrastructure capital priorities, oversee investment pipelines or report portfolio performance across public agencies and utilities.
modules: PIMA Portfolio Governance and Entry Gates
World Bank Climate Screening at Portfolio Scale
PIMA Portfolio Results and Decision Briefing
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public budgeting, infrastructure planning, capital investment decisions or utility investment processes is recommended. No coding or technical project-finance modelling is required.
